section_summary.extract_value: This section details the participants of a single study, referred to as 'this study'. A total of 215 heterosexual women, aged 18 and older, involved in romantic relationships for at least 12 months, were recruited from Ottawa, Canada, using posters, email listservs, social media, and snowball sampling. The sample was predominantly Caucasian (88.5%), highly educated (88% postsecondary), with a mean age of 38.08 years and a mean self-reported BMI of 26.11.
